name: Keen Mind
description:
You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits.
- You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to search for hidden compartments, illusions, or secret mechanisms.
- As long as you have viewed an accurate map of the area you are in, you can not get lost by nonmagical means.
- You have advantage on saving throws against Illusion spells.
- You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.
snippet: You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to search for hidden compartments, illusions, or secret mechanisms, and advantage on saving throws against Illusion spells.
